name: Orbit
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
An RD that uses an iteration step implemented to treat reagents a and b as a complex number (a+bi) and raising it to a power, similarly to a mandelbrot/julia orbits-fractal step.
Implemented by Dan Wills.
</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Orbit" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.06
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -1.5
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        1.5
      </param>
      <param name="constReal">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="constImag">
        -0.02
      </param>
      <param name="realPower">
        2.5
      </param>
      <param name="imagPower">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.69
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        1.2
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="mag_add">
        0.005
      </param>
      <param name="phase_offset">
        -0.02
      </param>
      <param name="phase_scale">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
c = pow(a*a + b*b, (float4)mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_add;
d = atan2( b, a ) * phase_scale + phase_offset;
delta_a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, (float4)realPower) * pow( (float4)2.718281828459045235360287471352f, (float4)(-imagPower*d) ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
delta_b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, (float4)realPower) * pow( (float4)2.718281828459045235360287471352f, (float4)(-imagPower*d) ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
